shellCommands.command: curl -s http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog -o /tmp/catalog.html; echo "---HTTP STATUS---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog; echo "---PRODUCT ROWS---"; grep -o 'Laptop\|Phone\|Tablet\|Headphones\|Watch' /tmp/catalog.html | sort -u; echo "---FORM/ACTION PRESENT---"; grep -c 'Sync latest catalog' /tmp/catalog.html; echo "---ACTION ID HINT---"; grep -o '\$ACTION_ID_[a-zA-Z0-9_]*' /tmp/catalog.html | head -3

echo "--- First request (cache miss/prerender) ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "time_total: %{time_total}s  x-nextjs-cache: %{header_x-nextjs-cache}\n" http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog; echo "--- Second request (should be cached) ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "time_total: %{time_total}s  x-nextjs-cache: %{header_x-nextjs-cache}\n" http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog; echo "--- Headers ---"; curl -sI http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog | grep -i 'x-nextjs-cache\|cache-control\|content-type'

cd /tmp && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
html = open('/tmp/catalog.html').read()
# Find the action id
m = re.search(r'\$ACTION_ID_([a-f0-9]+)', html)
print("ACTION_ID:", m.group(1) if m else None)
# Find action references in script tags
ids = re.findall(r'"\$ACTION_ID_([a-f0-9]+)"', html)
print("All action id refs:", ids[:5])
PY

ACTION_ID="008f94c5c596679f7a498553ce18445e766f5256b0"
echo "--- POST to Server Action ---"
curl -s -o /tmp/action_resp.txt -w "HTTP: %{http_code}\n" \
  -X POST "http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" \
  -H "Accept: text/x-component" \
  -H "Next-Action: ${ACTION_ID}" \
  -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%5D" \
  --data-binary '[{}]'
echo "--- Response (first 600 bytes) ---"
head -c 600 /tmp/action_resp.txt
echo
echo "--- Check for revalidation markers in response ---"
grep -c 'products' /tmp/action_resp.txt || true

echo "--- Request right after action (should show revalidation behavior) ---"
curl -sI http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog | grep -i 'x-nextjs-cache\|cache-control\|age'
echo "--- Body still has products (stale-while-revalidate serves content) ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3137/admin/catalog | grep -o 'Laptop\|Phone' | sort -u
